reality_check: The PI group must demonstrate scientific synergy beyond a normal consortium. Confirm the PI composition and special Synergy requirements from the work programme.
action_note: Identify the PI and scientific idea, verify the 2027 eligibility rules and host commitment, and check prior grants and concurrent evaluations. Starting 2027 now primarily requires completion of developed proposals; future rounds allow candidate preparation.

title: ERC Plus Grant 2027
summary: Bottom-up frontier research, including theoretical and computational physics without a general commercialisation or high-TRL requirement. The basic project ceiling is EUR 7 million for 84 months, not an automatic institutional allocation. Additional funding has separate conditions.
reality_check: This route requires an exceptionally ambitious research concept. PLUS eligibility and application restrictions must be assessed separately for the proposed PI.
action_note: Identify the PI and scientific idea, verify the 2027 eligibility rules and host commitment, and check prior grants and concurrent evaluations. Starting 2027 now primarily requires completion of developed proposals; future rounds allow candidate preparation.

title: ERC Proof of Concept 2027
summary: The 2027 work programme plans opening on 12 November 2026, with deadlines on 10 March and 16 September 2027. The overall allocation is EUR 60 million; this scan did not separately verify the amount per project.
reality_check: Only eligible previous ERC grant holders with a related ERC result can use this route. It is not a general technology-transfer call for all UJF teams.
action_note: Check the originating ERC grant, PI, end date and rights to the result before selecting a submission deadline.

title: Horizon Europe Hop-on Facility 2026
summary: HORIZON-WIDERA-2026-03-WIDENING-01 closed on 24 September 2026 at 17:00 CEST. It adds a new research work package and widening partner to an eligible running Pillar II or EIC Pathfinder project. Expected additional contribution: EUR 0.2-0.6 million, at least 90% for the new partner and at most 10% for coordination.
reality_check: The target grant must meet the call's no-existing-widening-participant conditions, including the specified affiliated or associated roles. It must be 1-12 months from the project start, still in its first reporting period. The existing coordinator submits with consortium agreement; this is not top-up funding for an existing UJF participation.
action_note: The listed entry date has passed. Follow submitted proposals only; a later evaluation or successor call does not automatically reopen entry.

title: Research Management Facility 2026
summary: HORIZON-WIDERA-2026-04-WIDENING-01 closed on 24 September 2026. The expected EUR 7 million contribution is for a European facility delivering needs assessment, training and implementation plans, not a local grant-office allocation.
reality_check: Requires a widening coordinator and at least three independent entities in three EU/associated countries, including two EU countries. The facility supports assessment and planning, not implementation of institutional strategies themselves.
action_note: The listed entry date has passed. Follow submitted proposals only; a later evaluation or successor call does not automatically reopen entry.

title: ERA Research Managers 2027
summary: HORIZON-WIDERA-2027-02-WIDENING-02 is planned for 6 April to 14 September 2027. The allocation is EUR 65 million, with an expected EUR 1.5-2.5 million contribution per project for lasting institutional research-management change at a widening beneficiary.
reality_check: Requires a named experienced external manager without an existing contractual relationship with the beneficiary, at least 50% FTE on site until a permanent leader is appointed by month 36, and limits on existing staff joining the new team. At most half the new team may come from pre-existing contractual relationships. This is not blanket reimbursement of current administration or software.
action_note: Obtain an institutional commitment to the reform, external recruitment and permanent capacity before developing the candidate and project budget.

title: ERA Chairs 2027
summary: HORIZON-WIDERA-2027-02-WIDENING-01 is planned for 6 April to 14 September 2027. The allocation is EUR 175 million, with an expected EUR 1.5-2.5 million per project, typically over five years, for scientific leadership and institutional change.
reality_check: Requires an excellent external scientific leader, a credible team and institutional reform. It is distinct from ERA Research Managers and is not an unrestricted PI research budget; confirm the full personnel rules for the chosen candidate.
action_note: Identify the strategic scientific gap, international candidate and long-term institutional commitments before designing the application.

title: Excellence Hubs 2027
summary: HORIZON-WIDERA-2027-04-WIDENING-01 has been open since 2 September 2026 and closes on 4 March 2027. Expected funding is EUR 1.5-4.5 million for the whole project connecting regional innovation ecosystems.
reality_check: At least two ecosystems in two widening countries are required, each linking research, businesses, public administration and society, including a business with at least two years of turnover. A pair of research institutes alone is insufficient.
action_note: Confirm the regional partners and genuine joint innovation or investment priorities, with a specific UJF scientific or technology role.

title: HORIZON-INFRA-2027-DEV-01-01 - Preparatory Phase of New ESFRI Infrastructures
summary: Opening is planned for 9 March 2027, with a 15 June deadline. Potential UJF role: preparation of a qualifying new European research infrastructure. Topic allocation: EUR 30 million; expected contribution: EUR 1.5-3.5 million per whole project. These are indicative contributions, not guaranteed minimum/maximum grants or the UJF share.
reality_check: Eligibility is restricted to qualifying new ESFRI infrastructures. National membership does not itself qualify a proposal; this is not a routine CANAM equipment upgrade. The UJF budget and complete consortium and cost conditions remain to be established.
action_note: Identify the specific topic and existing European infrastructure partners, document their eligibility and agree a concrete UJF service or technology contribution.

summary: Opening is planned for 9 March 2027, with a 15 June deadline. Potential UJF role: integration of complementary methods and services across European networks. Topic allocation: EUR 20 million; expected contribution: EUR 2-5 million per whole project. These are indicative contributions, not guaranteed minimum/maximum grants or the UJF share.
reality_check: A consortium integrating eligible pan-European infrastructures is needed; confirm the complete eligible infrastructure scope. The UJF budget and complete consortium and cost conditions remain to be established.
action_note: Identify the specific topic and existing European infrastructure partners, document their eligibility and agree a concrete UJF service or technology contribution.

title: RIANA - Transnational Access
summary: Rolling access to RIANA nanoscience facilities where the nanoscale below 100 nm is essential to the project. Access is free; eligible visits may reimburse up to two travellers, with travel up to EUR 300 per person and accommodation up to EUR 100 per person per night against receipts.
reality_check: The PI and majority of the team must work outside the host facility's country, and results must be published. A Czech team using the Czech Tandetron does not meet transnationality. Experiments must take place within 18 months of acceptance; approval is not guaranteed.
action_note: Select the scientific question and an eligible foreign facility, optionally discuss a pre-proposal, then submit the full access request through ARIA.

title: RIANA - Staff Exchanges
summary: Rolling short exchanges for junior or young staff employed by RIANA partner infrastructures, usually around one week. Support covers eligible travel and accommodation up to EUR 1,000. The EUR 23,000 programme total through project month 36 is not a confirmed remaining balance.
reality_check: The host must be outside the applicant's specific RIANA network. Usually one applicant per facility is supported and the applicant must not already be a user of the host. Eligibility and available funds require confirmation.
action_note: Agree a one-page training plan and obtain sending and receiving approvals before requesting support and booking travel.

title: RIANA - Invite an Expert
summary: Rolling support for expert participation in a network meeting, with up to EUR 1,000 as a partial contribution to eligible travel costs. The limit is one supported invitation per network per year, not per institute.
reality_check: This is not full event funding. The network coordinator must submit the request at least six months before the event, subject to approval and available funds.
action_note: Agree the expert and scientific purpose with the network coordinator and plan the request at least six months ahead.

title: AV CR Researchers at Risk - Fourth Round 2027-2029
summary: The fourth Researchers at Risk Fellowship round is announced for January 2027, supporting placements during 2027-2029 with up to 24 months of salary support. No exact opening day, deadline or award amount is established in this scan.
reality_check: Requires a specific eligible at-risk researcher and a credible host and work plan. The announced round is not yet an open application window.
action_note: Assess a candidate and hosting capacity and check the official January announcement for final eligibility, salary rules and dates.

title: CZELO Brussels Internship for AV CR Project Offices
summary: Applications are open from 18 September to 30 October 2026 for the Brussels internship on 12-16 April 2027. Up to ten participants are selected from AV CR project offices; English at least at B2 level is required.
reality_check: All travel and accommodation costs are borne by the sending institute. This is a training opportunity, not a cash grant or a reimbursement from the Academy Office.
action_note: Select an eligible project-office staff member for the 12-16 April 2027 Brussels internship and secure the institute's travel and accommodation budget before 30 October. Prioritise a concrete pre-award or European R&D policy learning objective.

title: COST SHARP (CA24159) - Hadron Structure and Spectroscopy
summary: SHARP runs from 20 October 2025 to 19 October 2029. Working-group participation can be requested through e-COST; relevant routes include WG1/WG2 for theory and WG4 for instrumentation.
reality_check: Both Czech Management Committee seats are occupied. Working-group entry is separate from national representation and from funded mobility; an active STSM or school funding call was not verified.
action_note: Apply for the scientifically relevant working group and discuss a concrete contribution; confirm any mobility funding separately.

title: COST MLQC4FC (CA24146) - ML and Quantum Computing for Future Colliders
summary: An active network for machine learning and quantum computing in future-collider science, including simulation, reconstruction and physics data. This is not a general institutional or office-AI programme.
reality_check: The official COST page offers working-group applications through e-COST. Group membership is separate from Management Committee nomination and any funded mobility call. No currently open STSM or other individual grant is established by that membership route.
action_note: Use an e-COST profile to apply to the scientifically relevant working group with a concrete collider-physics, ML or quantum-computing contribution. Confirm any travel or mobility award separately.

title: COST ICED (CA25144) - Laser-target Supply Chain for Inertial Fusion
summary: ICED runs from 9 September 2026 to 8 September 2030. Potential UJF roles include ion modification, target characterisation and fuel metrology, particularly in WG4/WG5. Working-group applications are available through e-COST.
reality_check: Participation is distinct from a grant award. Confirm national Management Committee availability through the appropriate national process; the main proposer is not automatically the current Action chair. No specific open mobility award was verified.
action_note: Define a target-related measurement or materials contribution, apply to a suitable working group and check future mobility opportunities separately.

title: Horizon Health 2027 - Exposome and Climate-related Health Impacts
summary: HORIZON-HLTH-2027-01-ENVHLTH-02 is planned to open on 10 February and close on 13 April 2027. The expected contribution is EUR 10-11 million per whole project. Potential UJF input is exposure reconstruction and isotope-based measurements within an exposome study.
reality_check: Requires an epidemiological and environmental-health consortium with a demonstrated climate-health question. The UJF budget and detailed eligible costs have not been established; analytical capability alone is not enough.
action_note: Identify an appropriate health or environmental coordinator and define a measurable exposure-related work package before developing the consortium budget.

title: Horizon Health 2027 - Predictive Biomarkers and AI-enabled Tools (Topic Summary)
summary: HORIZON-HLTH-2027-02-TOOL-01-two-stage is planned to open on 10 February 2027. Mandatory first-stage proposals are due 13 April; full proposals on 22 September are only for advancing applicants. Expected contribution: EUR 6-8 million per whole project.
reality_check: A clinical partner and validated biomarker or measurement contribution are required. This is not a general AI call. The title here is abbreviated; the full topic scope and UJF-specific cost eligibility remain to be checked.
action_note: Match a validated radiochemical or measurement capability to a clinical use case with an eligible consortium and prepare for the first stage.

title: ERDERA Clinical Trial Call 2026 - Invited Short Proposals Only
summary: Expressions of interest closed on 10 September 2026. Short proposals are due 29 October only for invited or advancing consortia; this is not a new-entry deadline. Funding is coordinated centrally through Fondazione Telethon, not a Czech AZV national allocation.
reality_check: A clinical sponsor and a specific justified clinical-trial role are essential. Czech eligibility does not establish a UJF budget. Limits, costs and rules for adding a participant to an already registered consortium require confirmation.
action_note: Follow only an eligible invited consortium and confirm whether a specific UJF radiochemistry or dosimetry contribution can be included under the existing registration.

title: AV CR Mobility Plus - 2027 Starts, Closed
summary: The Mobility Plus intake for projects starting in 2027 closed on 8 June 2026. The future project start does not mean that a September application window is open.
reality_check: This entry is retained only to distinguish submitted mobility proposals from currently open international cooperation opportunities.
action_note: Follow submitted proposals and any official successor announcement; do not prepare a new application against the closed 2027-start round.

title: RADNEXT 2030 - Transnational Access to Irradiation Facilities
summary: The RADNEXT irradiation-access round closed on 7 October 2026 at 23:59 CEST. It offered beam time for radiation-effects testing, including electronics and detectors, with conditional travel support. This was facility access, not a research-grant budget for UJF.
reality_check: The user group leader and majority of team members must work outside the host facility's country. Results must be disseminable under the access rules, with the stated SME exception. Access is competitively selected; travel funding and technical suitability are not automatic.
action_note: Follow submitted experiments and watch for the next officially announced access round. Do not treat the closed October round as rolling intake.

title: E-RIHS - Third Call for Heritage Science Access
summary: The third E-RIHS access round closed on 15 October 2026 at noon. MOLAB, FIXLAB, ARCHLAB and DIGILAB offered heritage-science services and resources, including potential AMS, dating and archaeometry applications. This was infrastructure access, not a conventional research grant.
reality_check: Choose a technically suitable service and a genuine heritage-science question. Applications must be in English, include a data management plan and the required documents, and name at least one catalogue service. MOLAB activities are limited to one location per application. The public page does not specify the time zone for noon; confirm it with the portal.
action_note: Follow submitted access proposals and the next confirmed catalogue call; no new application can enter the third round.

title: COST ENRICH (CA24131) - Radiation Detection Research and Innovation
summary: ENRICH runs until 15 October 2029 and connects radiation-detection research across nuclear and atomic physics, instrumentation, simulations, medicine and heritage science. Working-group applications are available through COST; this is a networking and collaboration route, not direct experimental research funding.
reality_check: Both Czech Management Committee seats are occupied. Working-group participation remains a separate route and does not guarantee travel, STSM or training funding. Verify each individual mobility or event call separately.
action_note: Select a relevant working group and apply through e-COST with a concrete detector, electronics, measurement or simulation contribution. Discuss scientific participation before assuming a funded activity.

title: EuroHPC QTI-13 - Quantum-Testing Infrastructure
summary: HORIZON-JU-EUROHPC-2026-QTI-13-01 closes on 17 November 2026 at 17:00 CET. It supports a pan-European quantum testing and validation infrastructure. The topic budget is EUR 20 million, with an expected EUR 19-20 million contribution and one indicative grant, not a UJF budget.
reality_check: The proposal must implement the testing-related action plan of the Qu-Test Framework Partnership Agreement. A generic new quantum consortium is not enough: confirm the existing partnership, participant eligibility and any route for UJF to join. The infrastructure validates quantum components, sensors and systems; the portal describes progression of tested technologies from TRL 3/4 to 5/7, not a TRL for testing itself.
action_note: Explore only a specific metrology, characterisation or testing role with the established Qu-Test-linked consortium and verify the legal participation route before committing to an application.

title: EuroHPC QEXP-14 - Quantum Experimental Pilot Lines
summary: HORIZON-JU-EUROHPC-2026-QEXP-14-01 closes on 17 November 2026 at 17:00 CET. It supports experimental quantum fabrication and pilot production, targeting reproducibility and manufacturability at TRL 4-6. The topic budget is EUR 15 million, with an expected EUR 14-15 million contribution and one indicative grant, not a UJF allocation.
reality_check: The action implements the pilot-production elements of the Qu-Pilot Framework Partnership Agreement and connects toward Chips JU pilot lines. Confirm partnership access and participant eligibility; a standalone materials proposal or unconnected new consortium does not address this requirement.
action_note: Discuss a defined materials, fabrication, sensor or characterisation task with the established Qu-Pilot-linked consortium. Confirm eligibility, the full budget conditions and the UJF role before allocating proposal effort.
source_label: EuroHPC JU - Quantum Experimental Pilot Lines

title: MIT-Czech Republic IOCB Foundation Seed Fund 2026

The fund supports 3-5 new collaborations annually, with roughly 20 months for completion.
reality_check: A concrete MIT partner and a credible joint collaboration plan are essential. This is seed and mobility support, not a general laboratory, equipment or research-salary grant. The annual USD 100,000 fund contribution is not the amount per project or for UJF.

summary: A CSA to strengthen venture-building functions in research-performing organisations; deadline 2 February 2027, 17:00 CET.
reality_check: Requires institutional commitment to venture-building, not just one potential commercial result.
action_note: Check institutional capacity before considering a network role.

title: HORIZON-CL4-2027-01-MAT-PROD-16 - Raw Materials Processing
summary: An innovation action for improved raw-material processing technologies; deadline 2 February 2027, 17:00 CET.
reality_check: Needs an industrial process and integrator. Analytical capabilities alone do not establish fit.
action_note: Validate an identifiable measurement contribution within an industrial consortium.

title: HORIZON-CL4-2027-02-MAT-PROD-32 - Renewable Energy in Process Industries
summary: The two-stage innovation topic targets efficient renewable-energy input in process industries. The first stage closes on 2 February 2027; only advancing applicants enter the full-proposal stage.
reality_check: A real industrial process and integrator are needed. The first-stage deadline is not interchangeable with the later full-proposal deadline.
action_note: Confirm the process-integration case and first-stage requirements with the consortium.

title: HORIZON-RAISE-2027-01-01 - Automated Scientific Discovery
summary: The RAISE pilot RIA supports automated scientific discovery. It closes on 2 February 2027 at 17:00 CET; materials science is a possible UJF application, not the whole official topic title.
reality_check: A credible AI-driven experimentation and validation approach is needed. Conventional measurements without an integrated discovery workflow are not enough.
action_note: Develop an experimental/data contribution with AI and automation partners against the full topic scope.

title: HORIZON-RAISE-2027-01-04 - Data Lab for Science
summary: A CSA to develop a Data Lab for Science model linking EOSC and RAISE. Deadline: 2 February 2027, 17:00 CET.
reality_check: Requires coordination across a research-data ecosystem. This is not funding for routine software purchases or a single data-management plan.
action_note: Assess an actual scientific-data contribution within an EOSC/RAISE consortium.

title: HORIZON-CL4-2027-SPACE-03-71 - Quantum Space Gravimetry
summary: The 2027 pipeline plans opening on 9 March and closing on 2 September for quantum space gravimetry.
reality_check: Requires gravimetric sensor expertise, space validation and an appropriate consortium. General quantum or radiation research does not itself qualify; confirm final call conditions at opening.
action_note: Explore a specific sensor, materials or validation role with space partners.

title: HORIZON-CL3-2027-01-BM-03 - Illicit Material Detection in Cargo
summary: The planned security topic includes radiological detection applications. Opening is scheduled for 5 May 2027, with a 4 November deadline.
reality_check: The source specifies at least two customs authorities from two countries as beneficiaries. UJF cannot substitute for the required operational end users; verify the full topic before forming the team.
action_note: Develop detector or measurement tasks with customs end users and a system integrator.

title: HORIZON-CL3-2027-01-DRS-01 - Protection against CBRN-E Risks
summary: Protective systems for CBRN-E risks are planned for a 5 May to 4 November 2027 call window.
reality_check: An operational protection use case, qualified end users and system integration are necessary. UJF's role must be a specific validated measurement or materials task.
action_note: Check end-user and participation requirements in the final topic before joining a consortium.

title: MSCA Choose Europe for Science 2027
summary: REA plans to open the institutional recruitment scheme on 8 December 2026. The confirmed submission timetable and supporting documents must be checked at opening.
reality_check: Requires a sustainable career offer and institutional commitments. It is not an unrestricted individual travel or fellowship application.
action_note: Assess the host's long-term employment and financing capacity before preparing a programme.

title: MSCA Staff Exchanges 2027
summary: REA plans opening on 15 December 2026. A confirmed application deadline is not established by this update.
reality_check: Needs an eligible international/intersectoral secondment network and host arrangements. Staff-month support is not an unrestricted experimental research budget.
action_note: Prepare an eligible exchange network and check the final timetable and unit-cost rules at opening.

title: MSCA COFUND 2027
summary: Opening is planned for 8 December 2026. This is an opening date, not a submission deadline; the final timetable remains to be confirmed.
reality_check: Requires a co-funded doctoral or postdoctoral programme and institutional capacity. A doctoral route needs a degree-awarding partner; UJF cannot claim university awarding powers.
action_note: Check programme scale, co-financing and university partnerships before developing an institutional application.

title: ERA4Health NanoDiagNCD 2027 - Czech Funding Unconfirmed
summary: The pre-announcement plans opening on 17 November 2026 and pre-proposals on 19 January 2027 at noon CET. Full proposals on 9 June are for invited teams only.
reality_check: Czech national funding is not established in the current pre-announcement. A possible self-funded collaboration is not a grant award for UJF. Clinical relevance and translation must be demonstrated.
action_note: Verify participating funders and Czech eligibility before committing to a funded consortium role.

title: ERA4Health IICS4all 2027 - Investigator-Initiated Clinical Studies
summary: Planned opening is 27 October 2026 for multinational pragmatic phase III randomised clinical studies, including underrepresented populations. The submission deadline is not confirmed in this update.
reality_check: Needs a clinical coordinator and a qualifying disease and trial design; laboratory radiopharmaceutical research alone is insufficient. Czech funding conditions remain subject to the final national annex.
action_note: Consider only a clearly defined role in a clinically led proposal and verify the opening documentation.

title: ESA Open Space Innovation Platform
summary: OSIP provides an entry route for ideas under individual ESA campaigns and channels, each with its own schedule.
reality_check: Submitting an idea does not guarantee a grant or contract. Selection, geography, technology scope and funding conditions are campaign-specific.
action_note: Identify a live matching campaign and verify its terms before submitting a concrete space-technology idea.

title: PIANOFORTE - Early-Career Researcher Travel Grants
summary: Up to EUR 1,000 per person for a conference, course or research visit. Applications are rolling, with quarterly assessment; the next cutoff is 31 December 2026, not closure of the whole scheme.
reality_check: For MSc/PhD students or researchers within seven years of their PhD, affiliated in the EU or Ukraine. Travel must be abroad; passive conference attendance is not supported. Funding is normally reimbursed after the activity, once per person per year; consortium membership is not required.
action_note: Prepare the relevant abstract or host/course acceptance, supervisor support and eligible travel budget before the next cutoff.

title: PIANOFORTE - Early-Career Radiation Protection Professional Travel
summary: Up to EUR 1,000 for professional conferences, training or exchange visits. Rolling applications are assessed quarterly, with the next cutoff on 31 December 2026.
reality_check: Applicants must be within seven years of starting a radiation-protection career and affiliated in the EU or Ukraine. Travel abroad and active participation are required; reimbursement follows completion. This is personal mobility support, not a research-project grant.
action_note: Check career eligibility and obtain programme/host confirmation, a support letter and an eligible budget.

title: PIANOFORTE - Fourth Transnational Call 2027, Advance Notice
summary: A fourth transnational call is being prepared for 2027. No confirmed application dates or funding amounts are established in this update.
reality_check: Czech funder participation and UJF financial eligibility must be confirmed from the final call. Stakeholder preparation is not open intake.
action_note: Develop scientific interests and potential partnerships while monitoring the formal announcement and Czech funding route.

title: JRC PNT-TOSCA - GNSS Spaceborne Receiver Access
summary: The access call closes on 30 November 2026 at 23:45 CET. It tests GNSS spaceborne receivers for Space Service Volume applications, especially Galileo signals. The stated facility fee is EUR 0 excluding consumables; no travel/subsistence user-stay days are allocated.
reality_check: Ordinary space-radiation detectors or dosimetry do not meet this specific GNSS scope. Institutional, nationality, security and data/IP conditions apply.
action_note: Proceed only with a compatible receiver experiment and a viable travel and consumables budget.

title: HORIZON-BRIDGING-2027-02-05 - Advancing Pillar II Results
summary: Opened on 20 October 2026, with a 28 January 2027 deadline and EUR 32.5 million indicative call budget. It supports further development of promising Horizon Europe Pillar II results.
reality_check: Requires eligible results from a completed collaborative Pillar II project and rights to use them. H2020 or Euratom participation alone does not establish eligibility; check project provenance and consortium limits in the topic.
action_note: Identify an eligible completed project's result and access rights before building the follow-on proposal.

title: HORIZON-BRIDGING-2027-06-02 - Results via Innovation Ecosystems
summary: Opened on 20 October 2026; deadline 16 February 2027. The indicative topic budget is EUR 20 million for using Horizon Europe results through innovation ecosystems.
reality_check: Requires operational transfer and ecosystem capacity, including any third-party funding obligations specified in the topic. Scientific expertise alone is not enough.
action_note: Assess a concrete partnership and result-use role with an experienced innovation coordinator.

title: ESA Exploration Science - Co-Funded PhD Proposals
summary: ESA lists a 30 October 2026 deadline for co-funded PhD research proposals.
reality_check: Needs a degree-awarding university, an eligible ESA topic and confirmed co-financing. UJF's independent eligibility and the funding rate are not established by the public listing.
action_note: Check the detailed ESA campaign with the university before committing.

title: ESA MAGPIE - Science Advisory Team
summary: Applications for the mission's advisory team close on 30 October 2026.
reality_check: A specialist scientific role, not a standard research grant. Detailed selection conditions require checking in the ESA campaign.
action_note: Assess a specific expert against the mission requirements.

title: ESA/DLR COMPACT Plasma - Science Definition Team
summary: The science-definition team call closes on 30 November 2026.
reality_check: Expert participation does not imply a grant. Confirm the actual plasma experiment scope and selection criteria before claiming UJF eligibility.
action_note: Review the ESA/DLR campaign for a matching expert contribution.

title: ESA - Orbital High-Throughput Screener AO-2026-OHTS
summary: The orbital screener opportunity closes on 3 November 2026.
reality_check: Only a platform-compatible experiment is relevant. Detailed access conditions and UJF cost coverage remain unconfirmed.
action_note: Verify technical compatibility in the campaign before pursuing access.

title: ESA CORA - Ground-Based Facilities
summary: Continuously open access to specialised ground facilities.
reality_check: The experiment must fit ESA's platform and eligibility rules; a grant for UJF costs is not automatic.
action_note: Check the relevant facility and campaign terms.

title: ESA CORA - Parabolic Flight
summary: Continuously open access for flight-compatible research.
reality_check: Requires a suitable experiment, safety clearance and confirmed cost arrangements.
action_note: Verify campaign and payload requirements.

title: ESA CORA - Topical Teams
summary: Continuously open proposals for focused scientific teams.
reality_check: Networking support is not automatic experimental funding; confirm campaign scope and participation rules.
action_note: Develop a defined scientific objective with partners.
